_about: Host-side checks on what a guest sends. guard: each guest runner sample is compared with the last one the host accepted. A speed over max_speed_mps * speed_slack (metres per second, from the two sample times), a jump over teleport_distance_m in one sample on the same floor, or a sample inside solid ground (noclip) is a strike; at most one strike per strike_cooldown_seconds; a strike is forgiven after strike_decay_seconds of clean samples; kick_strikes strikes ask the host to remove the guest. min_dt_seconds floors the time between two samples so a burst cannot divide by zero. requests: the guest-to-host asks (SubmitEvent with a 'what' field) the host acts on; anything not in allowed is dropped. owner_only asks need the room owner. Text and ids are clamped to the limits here. packs: refuse_on_mismatch makes a guest leave a room whose mod packs differ; off, it only warns.
